name: Fast Arrow
author: Addicting Games
description:
Fast Arrow is a target and shooting game. With Fast Archer, you can become the dead-eyed marksman you've always wanted to be and you won't have to worry about proper posture or tugging a 50-pound bow.  Take aim at the spinning target and try to land a shot on its sie as it spins toward infinity. The real challenge isn't landing a shot, that should be easy after all your arrow goes in a straight line directly to the target. The real challenge will come after you've landed a few arrows and you want to land some more. You will be scored on how many different arrows you are actually able to land successfully on the spinning target without accidentally hitting one of your own previously shot arrows.

The more arrows your fire, the more space you will take up, this will require you to plan your moves and be more careful. There are dozens of different strategies, all of them require you to pay attention to the spinning wheel and have a pretty good idea of how long it will take for an arrow to hit the target after you've fired it.
